title: Fluid-Structure interactions with Navier- and full-slip boundary conditions
summary: We show the existence of weak solutions to the fluid-structure interaction problem of a largely deforming viscoelastic bulk solid with a viscous fluid governed by the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. In contrast to previous works, the fluid is allowed to slip along the solid boundary; namely, the so called Navier-slip boundary conditions are considered. Such boundary conditions naturally involve the time-changing outer normal of the fluid domain.
